maudhui: (1) The President as one part of Parliament shall exercise all the authority vested in him by this Constitution for that purpose. (2) The second part of Parliament shall be the principal organ of the United Republic which shall have authority, on behalf of the people, to oversee and advise the Government of the United Republic and all its organs in the discharge of their responsibilities in accordance with this Constitution. (3) For the purposes of exercising its authority, Parliament may - (a) ask any Minister any question concerning public affairs in the United Republic which is within his responsibility; (b) debate the performance of each Ministry during the annual budget session of Parliament; (c) debate and approve any long-term or short-term plan intended to be implemented; (d) enact legislation where implementation requires legislation; and (e) debate and ratify all treaties concerning the United Republic.
